points: Seven pledgers: Elsevier, Frontiers, Google, Mistral AI, Novo Nordisk Foundation, NVIDIA, Sanofi
Google gives $3M in cloud credits plus access to DeepMind science models; Frontiers over €1.6M in data services
Novo Nordisk Foundation intends to open its Gefion AI supercomputer to European researchers
read: European Commission, RAISE pledging initiative page, launched 15 October 2026 at the European AI in Science Summit, Dublin
take: Europe's RAISE programme adds private resources for AI-driven research; useful for R&D-heavy firms partnering with universities, though most pledges are unquantified.
title: EU Commission: industry pledges compute and models for AI science
